title: Balanced Latin Rectangles: Improved Published Upper Bounds via Simple Local Search
description:
Verified upper bounds for the 51 non-square instances in CP 2025 Table 1: 33 improved, 18 matched. Mean reduction over improved instances: 18.5%. Final values use up to 16 allocated CPU minutes per instance. Separate historical first-improvement measurements have a pooled median of 0.12 CPU seconds over 165 runs on the 33 improved instances. These are not controlled cross-study speedups.

Includes rectangles, raw quality-run output, historical timing CSV, exact checker, 14 published example fixtures, solver, reproducibility scripts, figures, and LaTeX/PDF. Historical timing-run stdout, stderr and build provenance are unavailable; the revised runner archives these for future runs. Improved values are upper bounds, not optimality certificates.

Code: MIT. Data, figures and paper: CC BY 4.0.
